title: Only 2 document profiles fully implemented
description: Only 2 document profiles exist (nda-mutual.json, patent-application.json). The 23 other golden set documents and 375+ catalogue entries lack profiles with: pre-draft questions, structured outlines, clause families, jurisdiction awareness, verification requirements.
impact: Routing works but drafting falls back to generic template or fails. No structured questionnaire, no clause intelligence, no jurisdiction adaptation.
root_cause: Phase 2 domain agents (2-8) created agent definitions but did not produce document profiles for their domains.
remediation: Each domain agent must produce profiles for their golden set documents before L3 capability claimed.
regression_test: Profile existence check: all 25 golden set documents must have profile in data/documents/profiles/.
